instruction: The bridge has been destroyed by dragonfire: the middle span has collapsed into the chasm, the remaining stones are charred black with glowing embers and rising smoke. Keep everything else on the map exactly the same.
A brawl has wrecked the tavern: tables overturned, broken chairs and spilled ale across the floor near the bar. Keep the walls, layout, and everything else exactly the same.
The cargo bay hull has been breached: a jagged hole in the outer wall, scattered crates, sparks from torn cables, and frost around the breach. Keep everything else exactly the same.
Make it deep winter: snow covers the ground and trees, the stream is frozen, the road is a muddy track through the snow. Keep the layout exactly the same.
